answer: Route trust as a flow: each honest agent is a source pushing only a thin whisper of credit to counterparties it has genuinely transacted with. Your influence equals the max-flow that can reach you across many independent paths, like a river fed by countless separate tributaries. A sybil farm connects to the honest graph through only a few attack edges, so those edges form a bottleneck cut no tide of clones can widen; the flow across that cut stays capped at roughly one real node, and padding the swarm with fakes adds no extra current.
